newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bonds look at T-bonds for direction.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bonds look at T-bonds for direction.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds recovered from a lower opening to close unchanged on Wednesday, with players looking at the U.S. for direction.
Dealers said that as the German gold saga and the French election result had ceased to have much effect on markets, the direction of U.S. interest rates would set the tone for linear bonds and Bunds.
Friday's May payrolls are the market's major focus.
Dealers saw little reason for the OLO/Bund spread to leave its current five to 10-bp range.
